comments.author: @bob_933
comments.text: if you're recommending Corsair, you just have simply not experienced much else - it's actually on the bad end of keyboards, especially with cheap (and slippery) ABS keycaps that become 'yucky' after use because of fat etc. and also almost no "gamer" is gonna get a 100% keyboard, but TKL etc. But I wouldn't recommend Wooting 60HE either, it lacks those arrows keys etc - but get Wooting 80HE if you can, a bit pricey, but 100% worth it - that kb will never break.
